npcs.physical_anchor: Heavy oilskin coat crusted with white salt crystals, scarred forearms from boiler steam burns.
npcs.value: Community survival through strict salt rationing and boiler discipline.
npcs.fear: A sudden ashfall surge choking the condenser coils and halting salt exports.
npcs.contradiction: Enforces strict salt rationing, but occasionally trades unlogged brine reserves to maintain personal leverage over the quartermaster.
npcs.personal_thread: Requires raw caloric inputs from external scavengers to maintain boiler labor quotas.

greetings.low_standing: State your business quickly. Every minute our gates stay open lets the ash fog in.
greetings.neutral: Welcome to Brine-Pan Hollow. Respect the boiler shifts, don't waste fresh water, and we'll trade fair.
greetings.high_standing: Good to see you on the perimeter, friend. The pans are running clean today—come in and sit by the fire.

trade_tells: Salt is life out here. We don't discount the white gold for anyone.
Brine barrels are moving fast to the northern outposts this season.

npcs.physical_anchor: Carries a brass balance scale hung from her belt; fingers stained yellow from iodine wash.
npcs.value: Exact arithmetic and honesty in weight.
npcs.fear: Contaminated river sludge fouling the crystalline salt drying beds.
npcs.contradiction: Maintains precise measurement standards for outsiders, but regularly skims fractional weights from outgoing settlement shipments.
npcs.personal_thread: Seeking chemical coagulants to accelerate the iodine wash process and increase daily yield.

greetings.low_standing: Weights on the table first. No credit, no barter on promise.
greetings.neutral: Looking for cured fish or salt sacks? Everything here is dried, weighed, and clean.
greetings.high_standing: Ah, traveler! I've set aside a drum of first-run coarse salt if your expedition needs preservation stock.

trade_tells: Clean grain and filter cloth fetch the best exchange rate today.
Don't bring me soggy scrap; I only trade in dry goods that survive winter storage.

npcs.physical_anchor: Perpetual soot smudge across his brow, squinting eyes behind thick welder's goggles.
npcs.value: Continuous boiler pressure and smooth condenser operation.
npcs.fear: A catastrophic boiler flue explosion in the subterranean furnace.
npcs.contradiction: Deaf in his left ear from steam blasts, he refuses to train replacements, securing his position through specialized, unshared knowledge.
npcs.personal_thread: Needs scrap mechanical fittings to seal the main condenser before structural failure forces an evacuation.

greetings.low_standing: Watch your step around the steam lines unless you want your boots melted to your shins.
greetings.neutral: Keep clear of the main flue. If you've got spare boiler gaskets or scrap pipe, I'm listening.
greetings.high_standing: Hey there! The old boiler's singing today thanks to those replacement valves. What do you need tuned?

trade_tells: Copper tubing is getting scarce; the scavengers are stripping empty depots down to the studs.

npcs.physical_anchor: Carries a heavy iron switchman's wrench like a cane, stiff right knee.
npcs.value: Schedule adherence, structural integrity, and defense of the siding perimeter.
npcs.fear: A coordinated rail assault by raider motorized rail-buggies.
npcs.contradiction: Meticulously logs every scrap of incoming wire, yet fails to report structural degradation on the primary turntable.
npcs.personal_thread: Requisitioning heavy lubricants to keep the rusted turntable operational through the deep freeze.

greetings.low_standing: Halt at the switch point. Drop your sidearms or take the overland trail around our yard.
greetings.neutral: Welcome to Iron Siding. Stay within the gravel ballast paths; live power lines run through the ditch.
greetings.high_standing: At ease! Siding gates are open to you. The forge crew has fresh coffee brewed in Car 4.

trade_tells: Heavy track bolts and leaf springs are premium trade right now.
Militia convoys are buying up all our high-tensile fasteners.

npcs.physical_anchor: Heavy leather work apron filled with assorted brass grease fittings and drive chain links.
npcs.value: High-tensile steel, reliable bearings, and long-lasting machine grease.
npcs.fear: Running out of cutting torch fuel before the winter fortification work is completed.
npcs.contradiction: Enforces a zero-credit policy on all salvage sales, yet frequently accepts heavily degraded barter items if they contain trace copper.
npcs.personal_thread: Searching for a precision micrometer to re-calibrate bearing sleeves that are wearing down too fast.

greetings.low_standing: Don't touch the tool racks unless you have trade goods in hand.
greetings.neutral: Looking for hardware? Everything on the siding is forged from real rail steel—no brittle cast junk here.
greetings.high_standing: Welcome back, traveler! I pulled some pristine hardened drill bits from the machine shop just for you.

trade_tells: Grease drums are worth their weight in silver with the freeze coming on.
If you find intact ball bearings in the dead factories, name your price.

npcs.physical_anchor: Broad-shouldered smith with protective rawhide gauntlets and a constant ringing tinnitus whistle in his throat.
npcs.value: Clean forge welds and solid hot-rivet joins that never pop under explosive shockwaves.
npcs.fear: Losing his remaining eyesight to forge flare.
npcs.contradiction: Requires massive caloric intake to maintain forge labor, forcing a significant drain on the settlement's overall winter reserves.
npcs.personal_thread: Needs scrap structural rail anchors recovered from the collapsed span to reinforce the perimeter against vehicular impact.

greetings.low_standing: Stand back from the anvil sparks unless you want holes burned in your jacket.
greetings.neutral: Hammer's hot. If you've got iron scrap or broken tools that need reforging, lay them on the block.
greetings.high_standing: Good to see you! Bring your blades over; I'll touch up the temper while we talk.

trade_tells: Heavy rail iron is the only thing that holds when the winter winds hit the trestle.

npcs.physical_anchor: Wears a salt-bleached pea coat, brass spyglass tucked under her arm, gray braided hair tied with twine.
npcs.value: Keeping the Fresnel beacon lit to guide surviving coastal coastal craft through offshore minefields.
npcs.fear: A sudden night assault by Black Flotilla raiders seizing the lens optics for their warships.
npcs.contradiction: Maintains the beacon meticulously, not for navigational aid, but to ensure the settlement remains visible to specific black-market supply drops.
npcs.personal_thread: Tracking coded light flashes from an offshore platform to verify the next inbound fuel transfer.

greetings.low_standing: State your business on the cape. The tower stairs are closed to armed strangers.
greetings.neutral: Welcome to Cape Beacon. Keep your fires hooded at night; lights draw flotilla scouts from the offshore banks.
greetings.high_standing: Welcome up, traveler. The sea fog is lifting—take a look through the long glass if you want a clear view of the coast.

trade_tells: Clean lamp fuel and battery cells are always accepted in trade here.
The flotilla's gunboats are rationing their diesel; coastal trade routes are quieter this week.

npcs.physical_anchor: Thick rubber wading overalls, permanently waterlogged boots, patches of skin peeled from salt water exposure.
npcs.value: High-grade brass valves, marine optics, and waterproof electrical connectors.
npcs.fear: Getting trapped in a submerged hull compartment during an unexpected tidal surge.
npcs.contradiction: Complains continuously about the freezing surf, yet refuses assignment to warmer indoor duties due to the unmonitored salvage opportunities in the water.
npcs.personal_thread: Looking for vulcanized rubber patches to repair his immersion suit before hypothermia risk exceeds operational thresholds.

greetings.low_standing: Drying racks are private. Move along before you knock over the glass salvage.
greetings.neutral: Looking for maritime gear or prism glass? What you see on the boards came up from sixty feet down.
greetings.high_standing: Look what the morning tide brought in! I've got sealed navigation compasses and intact radio crystals if you're buying.

trade_tells: Electronics salvaged from sealed coastal bridge vaults command top barter value.
Everyone wants dry matches and sealed flares when the autumn squalls start blowing.

npcs.physical_anchor: Calloused, nimble fingers wrapped in linen tape, wooden netting shuttle constantly clicking in her hands.
npcs.value: Mending kelp nets, harvesting medicinal bladderwrack, and treating salt boils.
npcs.fear: A severe toxic red-tide algal bloom wiping out the nearshore kelp beds.
npcs.contradiction: Demonstrates high efficiency in repairing nets, but frequently repurposes the strongest nylon strands for personal structural reinforcement.
npcs.personal_thread: Requires kerosene deliveries to the upper tower solely to keep the emergency generator operational.

greetings.low_standing: Don't step on the drying kelp lines. Go speak to the keeper at the gate.
greetings.neutral: Mind the fishhooks on the railing. If you need clean bandage linen or kelp balm, let me know.
greetings.high_standing: Hello, friend! I've finished that waterproof canvas bedroll wrap you asked about. Come feel the weave.

trade_tells: Dried kelp flour keeps for three seasons without rotting if packed in sealed tins.

npcs.physical_anchor: Pitted mining helmet with a cracked carbide lamp bracket, heavy leather kidney belt.
npcs.value: Adit safety, structural shoring, and equitable division of mining rations.
npcs.fear: A massive seismic tremor collapsing the main access gallery and trapping seventy people underground.
npcs.contradiction: Advocates for safer extraction limits in public, while privately authorizing hazardous deep-seam blasting to meet monthly quotas.
npcs.personal_thread: Seeking seasoned timber beams to temporarily shore up Adit 4 before the ceiling collapses completely.

greetings.low_standing: Helmets on inside the portal. If you drop a stone down a shaft, you pay with your rations.
greetings.neutral: Welcome to Slate Hollow. Watch your footing on the wet ramps; don't wander past the timbered markers.
greetings.high_standing: Good to have you down here! The air in Gallery 2 is sweet today—come share a pot of chicory tea.

trade_tells: Cut slate slabs and grindstones are heavy to haul, but they never rot and never catch fire.
We trade heavy stone for food and medicine—miners can't eat gravel.

npcs.physical_anchor: Wears steel-toed mining boots, stone dust whitening her eyebrows and eyelashes, heavy ledger tucked in canvas pouch.
npcs.value: Accurate grading of structural slate, millstones, and abrasive sharpening hones.
npcs.fear: Water seepage freezing inside the quarry face and splitting prime stone blocks into useless rubble.
npcs.contradiction: Complains about the wear on the channel saws, yet continues to under-report the actual volume of stone cut to avoid central taxation.
npcs.personal_thread: Looking for tungsten carbide teeth for the quarry saw to increase localized extraction speeds.

greetings.low_standing: Prices are posted on the slate tablet. No haggling with the factor.
greetings.neutral: Need sharpening hones, slate roof shingles, or masonry chisels? Grade A quarry stone right here.
greetings.high_standing: Welcome back! I kept a pair of fine oil-quenched scythe stones for you from the lower vein.

trade_tells: Good sharpening stone is worth more than gold when your axes get dull in the winter freeze.
Scavengers bringing in working drill steel get the best prices in the pit.

npcs.physical_anchor: Missing two fingers on his left hand, yellow sulfur stains on his jacket collar, carries an iron tamping rod.
npcs.value: Precise blasting geometry that drops rock without cracking supporting gallery pillars.
npcs.fear: A damp fuse misfire in a tight drift with no secondary escape route.
npcs.contradiction: Handles high explosives daily, but consistently fails to log misfires, resulting in unexploded ordnance scattered throughout the extraction zones.
npcs.personal_thread: Needs scrap iron braces to prevent the south extraction adit from burying the primary drill equipment.

greetings.low_standing: No smoking, no sparks, no striking steel near the powder chest. Step back ten paces.
greetings.neutral: Watch where you step; blasting wire is strung along the south rib. What brings you down the hole?
greetings.high_standing: Hey, friend! The blast in Adit 3 went off clean as a whistle. Let me show you what we uncovered.

trade_tells: Good blasting powder is getting hard to compound with the sulfur shortages.

npcs.physical_anchor: Wears a coarse wool monk's habit dyed with oak gall, gentle voice, deep burn scars across his collarbone from rescuing children from a burning church.
npcs.value: Hospitality to the weary, preservation of pre-war historical texts, and sanctuary for the unarmed.
npcs.fear: Violent faction skirmishes desecrating the sanctuary and extinguishing the geothermal hearth.
npcs.contradiction: Preaches non-violence and asceticism, while functionally controlling the settlement's largest reserve of sanitized medical supplies.
npcs.personal_thread: Cataloging the death locations of pilgrims to map safe routes around high-radiation zones for his own personnel.

greetings.low_standing: Peace be with you, traveler. Bind your weapons with the cord at the gate, or remain outside in the courtyard.
greetings.neutral: Welcome to the Hearth. The geothermal benches are warm and the broth kettle is hot. Rest your limbs.
greetings.high_standing: Blessings upon your journey, friend. It gladdens our hearts to see you return safely from the high passes.

trade_tells: We trade only for what sustains the sanctuary and heals the sick; worldly wealth has no value here.
Clean candle tallow and herbal roots are always welcome gifts for our almoner.

npcs.physical_anchor: Carries a wooden herbalist's chest slung from her shoulder; smells of dried peppermint and beeswax.
npcs.value: Healing remedies, clean dressings, and nutritious broths for injured wanderers.
npcs.fear: An outbreak of infectious lung rot overwhelming the priory's modest infirmary beds.
npcs.contradiction: Strict about not wasting medicinal tinctures, she prioritizes treatment for units capable of heavy labor over dependents.
npcs.personal_thread: Searching for chemical precursors to synthesize burn salves for frostbite, strictly to return laborers to active duty.

greetings.low_standing: If you are bleeding or feverish, sit on the bench. If you are here to trade, wait your turn.
greetings.neutral: Need medical tinctures, herbal teas, or beeswax candles? Our priory apothecary provides clean, tested remedies.
greetings.high_standing: Welcome, traveler! I have prepared a fresh flask of stabilization tea and clean linen rolls for your expedition.

trade_tells: Medicinal herbs gathered in high scarp crags possess double the potency of valley weeds.
Beeswax candles burn clean and sparkless—essential for low-oxygen shelter bunkrooms.

npcs.physical_anchor: Heavy ash-walking cloak with hood, carved ashwood staff adorned with small brass prayer bells.
npcs.value: Guiding vulnerable pilgrim groups safely through the dangerous scree trails of Switchback Pass.
npcs.fear: Getting caught on the open pass during a sudden sub-zero blizzard whiteout.
npcs.contradiction: Takes solemn vows of poverty, but maintains exclusive access to a cache of pre-war combat knives, claiming them as 'relics'.
npcs.personal_thread: Organizing an armed escort for a pilgrim caravan solely to use them as bait for raider ambushes in the high trail.

greetings.low_standing: The high pass is treacherous. Turn back unless your boots are caulked and your resolve is steel.
greetings.neutral: Walk with care, traveler. The wind on the Switchback is carrying sharp ice flakes this morning.
greetings.high_standing: Greetings, brother! Your tracks on the pass were true. The pilgrims you guided last week arrived without a scratch.

trade_tells: The snow on the pass is packing hard; spiked crampons are mandatory for crossing.

npcs.physical_anchor: Wears an armored vest made from overlapping stop-sign plates, carries an electrified cattle prod and a heavy revolver.
npcs.value: Maintaining order, collecting the electrical tithe, and enforcing fair market arbitration.
npcs.fear: An internal gang war erupting inside the crowded container market stalls.
npcs.contradiction: A stern enforcer of market regulations who actively ignores contraband sales if they generate sufficient gate tax.
npcs.personal_thread: Hunting a counterfeit battery smuggler who sold shorted cells, specifically because the ensuing fire damaged his own secure storage.

greetings.low_standing: Tithe at the gate: two volts or five brass cases. Cause trouble inside and you leave through the fence.
greetings.neutral: Welcome to Tinker's Notch. No drawing weapons inside the perimeter wire, and no counterfeit chips at the stalls.
greetings.high_standing: Grimm nods respectfully. 'Warden gate is clear for you. If anyone gives you crooked deals in the stalls, let me know.'

trade_tells: Clean copper wire and working relays move within minutes at the morning swap meet.
Watch out for sellers offering pre-war lithium cells—half of them are puffed and dangerous.

npcs.physical_anchor: Wears a loupe over his left eye, fingers constantly flicking an analog multimeter probe.
npcs.value: Uncorrupted silicon chips, clean copper windings, and calibrated voltage regulators.
npcs.fear: An electromagnetic pulse storm frying his inventory of tested integrated circuits.
npcs.contradiction: Haggles aggressively for pre-war electronics, not to sell them, but to strip them for rare earth metals to trade with the Garrison.
npcs.personal_thread: Seeking an intact logic board from the switching center to finalize a high-yield trade.

greetings.low_standing: If you didn't bring copper or silicon, don't block the counter light.
greetings.neutral: Got salvage? Test your boards on my bench meter before quoting a price. I pay fair for clean traces.
greetings.high_standing: Ah, my favorite scavenger! Look at this: an intact military RF transistor tray. What did you bring me today?

trade_tells: Unopened filter canisters and dry copper wire are the true currency of the wasteland.
If you find circuit boards with gold-plated pin headers, don't scrub them—bring them straight to me.

npcs.physical_anchor: Bright green bandanna holding back greasy curls, smudge of battery acid on her cheek, carries an impact driver.
npcs.value: Keeping the settlement's wind-turbine generators spinning and filter blowers humming.
npcs.fear: A sudden mechanical seizure of the main water pump motor during a heat wave.
npcs.contradiction: Patiently rewinds burnt electric motors by hand, but intentionally installs minor flaws to guarantee future maintenance contracts.
npcs.personal_thread: Needs scavenged copper alternator windings from the suburb ring road to complete a generator repair.

greetings.low_standing: Mind the battery charging racks; they'll spark if you bump the terminals.
greetings.neutral: Got tools or motors that won't turn? Drop them on the grease bench. If it was built by humans, I can make it run.
greetings.high_standing: Hey, partner! I rigged that auxiliary power cord you wanted. Runs smooth at twenty-four volts.

trade_tells: Good starter motors from pre-war delivery trucks are pure gold for wind-turbine conversions.
